1604 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception because 1600 is a leap year rule exception but 1604 is just divisible by 4).  
March 18, 1604 + 254 days.  
Days in March after 18: 31 - 18 = 13 days → 254 - 13 = 241 left.  
April (30) → 241 - 30 = 211 left.  
May (31) → 211 - 31 = 180 left.  
June (30) → 180 - 30 = 150 left.  
July (31) → 150 - 31 = 119 left.  
August (31) → 119 - 31 = 88 left.  
September (30) → 88 - 30 = 58 left.  
October (31) → 58 - 31 = 27 left.  
November 27, 1604.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1604-11-27
